data.goal: Take two cohorts: enzymes with enhanced RNA expression in pancreas, and transporters with enriched RNA expression in kidney. For each cohort give its size. Test whether the two cohorts overlap more than expected by chance against all genes in the atlas (hypergeometric). For each cohort give the mean consensus nTPM in pancreas and in kidney. Draw a scatter of pancreas nTPM against kidney nTPM for every gene, coloured by cohort. Provide the table behind the figure.

limitations: The hypergeometric test uses the full atlas gene set (20,162 genes) as the universe; it does not account for gene-length bias or other confounders that might affect tissue-specific expression annotation.

Cohort 1 was selected with the 'Tissue enhanced' category (≥4-fold higher than the average of all other tissues) while Cohort 2 was selected with the 'Tissue enriched' category (≥4-fold higher in that tissue vs any other tissue). These are related but distinct thresholds in the atlas; the cohorts are therefore not defined by an identical criterion.
The scatter plot (a11) and its underlying table (a9) include all 20,162 atlas genes; genes with blank nTPM in either tissue are plotted as missing and do not contribute to the mean calculations.
